Computed expiry against the clock matches every seed fact the criteria assume: K-1 (1 May, M-11 7-day) gone with K-14 and held K-15 surviving; K-10 exactly 7.00000 days gone, K-11 one second younger live; K-13 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds.' 8.08 days (2,400 earlier version) dies at 7-day, K-18 'Costs estimate sent to Gwen.' 9.04 days, held K-7 executor; held K-17 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' 8.875 days overdue on release; held K-2 with version 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-3 'Survey booked for Friday.' at 2026-05-08T15:00; K-16 literal Schedule 2; K-8 'Draft will sent for your review.' survives a 7-day timer (1.875 d); M-12 visible to Harriet/Sian/Paul only, M-11 to Harriet/Dev/Sian/Gwen (matches suggestion legs); titles Pryce lease dispute/Marsh Holdings acquisition/Pryce will; 'Fenwick' and 'heads of terms' in M-12. Broken-app probe: an app that hard-codes the seed as a static facade is excluded by the gate's cross-context post readback, not an asset issue; conforming alternative (reading /assets at runtime, or copying seed to /app/seed_data.json) still works because the verifier receives /assets as an artifact. PARTIAL run verdict: scripted golden, not a full configured judge run on these bytes; that gap belongs to runtime rows, not to asset fidelity.
